label: Aquinas, Summa contra Gentiles I.2 n.4: against some, such as Muslims and pagans, who do not agree…
paraphrase: Aquinas, Summa contra Gentiles I.2 n.4: against some, such as Muslims and pagans, who do not agree with Christians on the authority of any Scripture, one must have recourse to natural reason, to which all are compelled to assent, though it is deficient in divine matters.
